note: One of the largest species known from the Neotropical region; the alate measurements are of 11 individuals and the soldier measurements of the holotype and 15 paratypes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The alate differs from that of G. canellae in the slightly triangular ocelli, which are very close to the eyes (0.02 mm apart), and in the larger head and pronotum; compared with G. contracticornis all parts are smaller and the posterolateral margins of the pronotum are not rounded; compared with G. longipennis all parts are smaller. The soldier differs from those of the other known Neotropical species in the large and stout head, which bears a nodular rounded lobe on the frons; the long, stout mandibles with the outer base raised; the wavy posterior margin of the pronotum; and the long, strongly constricted postmentum.

The type locality is Barro Colorado Island, Canal Zone, Panama (9°10′ N, 79°51′ W); the alates (morphotype and paramorphotypes) and soldiers (holotype and paratypes) were collected by A. E. Emerson on 16 July 1935 (month 7), number 129; soldier paratypes from the same nest were collected on 2 June 1935 (month 6), number 102.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head, pronotum and nota yellow or brown; frontal region paler; postclypeus almost the same colour as the head; antennae and legs brownish yellow; wings smoky brown, in sharp contrast with the head and pronotum; wing scales paler than the dark parts of the wing. Head sparsely covered with long and short setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae; abdomen and legs with hairs of moderate density. Head oval. Y-suture visible but not prominent. Eyes shaped as figured. Ocelli slightly triangular, very close to the eyes (0.02 mm apart). Antennae 14—16-segmented; segment 3 variable, nearly as long as segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave, anterolateral corners rounded, the anterior sides slightly rounded, the posterior sides meeting the straight posterior margin at an angle. The media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 0.38 mm from the wing suture.

Measurements of 11 alates: head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.50—1.65 mm; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.20—1.28 mm; head width 1.32—1.41 mm; eye diameter 0.35—0.39 mm; distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.18—0.25 mm; ocellus length 0.12—0.14 mm; pronotum median length 0.71—0.78 mm; pronotum width 1.35—1.41 mm; length of the hind tibia 1.06—1.18 mm; forewing length from the suture 6.96—7.33 mm; forewing width 1.82—2.06 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head reddish brown, darker in front; mandibles nearly black, slightly paler at the base; pronotum brown, paler than the head; abdomen, legs and antennae pale yellow. Head with a few sparse erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae; abdomen and legs densely hairy. Head stout, the sides slightly converging forwards; frontal face nearly vertical in lateral view, forming a slope of about 50° in the middle; distinctly concave in the middle, forming two rounded lobes. Y-suture visible. Eyes oval. Mandibles stout, with a nodular swelling on the outer base; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth lying 0.38 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum widest in the anterior third, narrowest in the posterior third. Antennae 12—13-segmented; segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 equal to segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave with a median notch; sides rounded; posterior margin slightly wavy on each side and slightly angular where it meets the lateral margin. Femora stout and inflated.

Soldier measurements (holotype; range / mean of 15): head length (to the base of the mandibles) 2.40 mm / 2.26—2.55 mm / 2.35 mm; head width 1.80 mm / 1.73—1.83 mm / 1.78 mm; head height 1.58 mm / 1.50—1.65 mm / 1.56 mm; length of the left mandible 1.20 mm / 1.12—1.26 mm / 1.22 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.60 mm / 0.58—0.60 mm / 0.59 mm; postmentum minimum width 0.30 mm / 0.30—0.33 mm / 0.31 mm; postmentum length 1.58 mm / 1.35—1.58 mm / 1.48 mm; pronotum median length 0.75 mm / 0.67—0.77 mm / 0.72 mm; pronotum maximum length 1.05 mm / 0.83—1.05 mm / 0.94 mm; pronotum width 1.72 mm / 1.50—1.72 mm / 1.60 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.99 mm / 0.99—1.12 mm / 1.05 mm.
